Notes: VERIFY listing explicitly states N16R8 - many similarly priced "ESP32-S3 DevKit" listings are actually N8R2 or N4R2 (less flash/PSRAM). Also verify the board exposes TWO USB-C ports (native USB + UART) - single-port boards often only wire up the UART bridge, which blocks native USB HID/MIDI projects.
Tiny BLE/Wi-Fi board with a single native-USB USB-C port. Early production batches had a marginal onboard antenna/3.3V LDO - buy from a listing with recent (2024+) reviews.

Fun optional camera project board. Has NO onboard USB port - requires the FTDI/CP2102 adapter below to flash, plus jumpering GPIO0 to GND during reset to enter flash mode.
